title: 第3124章 不死神凰的涅盘第3123章 重瞳与仙光神魔与圣佛
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
叶馨叶欣对视一眼，眼中闪过一丝决绝。
“神魔一体，光暗同源，混沌初开！”
两人同时娇叱，神魔领域猛然收缩，然后轰然爆发！
神圣之光与黑暗魔气不再泾渭分明，而是疯狂交织，旋转，最终化作一片灰蒙蒙的、仿佛天地未开时的混沌之气！
这片混沌之气虽然远不如叶天和敖苍古的混沌本源深厚宏大，却蕴含着独特的光暗生灭，神魔转换的玄奥！
圣光长矛刺入这片初生的混沌之中，净化之力疯狂爆发，却如同泥牛入海。
被混沌之气不断消磨，分解，转化，长矛本身的光芒迅速黯淡。
金色佛掌拍入混沌，掌心的“卍”字佛印大放光芒，试图定住混沌。
却引得混沌之气剧烈翻腾，光暗之力在其中疯狂对冲，爆炸，竟将那佛掌生生炸得佛光溃散，虚影黯淡！
“什么？！”圣耀世与渡心同时惊呼，他们的全力一击，竟被这对双子以这种奇异的方式挡下甚至破去！
趁此机会，叶馨叶欣身影融入那片初生的混沌之中，气息变得飘忽不定，仿佛介于神圣与邪恶，存在与虚无之间。
她们的气息虽然因为刚才的爆发而略有下降，但眼神却更加明亮，对神魔之力的理解似乎更深了一层。
“涅盘之力，原来如此……”叶凰身处战场另一侧，她的对手是渡心分出的一部分佛光纠缠以及妖月璃那不时袭来的魅惑月华。
她周身九彩神火燃烧，将袭来的佛光灼烧净化，将那魅惑月华蒸发。
她的目光瞥见叶馨叶欣那边爆发的混沌初开景象，心中若有所悟。
她的先天神凰元灵圣体，核心便是“涅盘”与“神火”。涅盘是破而后立，是毁灭与新生。
神魔一体，光暗对冲，不也是一种极致的“毁灭”吗？
若能从中领悟到更深层次的“毁灭中孕育新生”的奥义，她的涅盘之道或许能更进一步。
“咯咯咯，叶凰妹妹，战斗时分心可不好哦。”妖月璃娇媚的声音在她耳边响起，一道冰冷彻骨，却又带着无尽诱惑的月华悄然袭向叶凰后心。
月华之中，隐约有无数妖娆身影曼舞，能乱人心神。

叶凰冷哼一声，头也不回，身后神火猛然爆发，化作一只振翅欲飞的神凰虚影。
神凰长鸣，炽烈的神火将那袭来的魅惑月华，连同其中的妖影一同焚烧殆尽。
“妖女，你的把戏对我无用。”叶凰转身，眸中神火锁定妖月璃那在月华中若隐若现的身影。
她不喜欢这种诡谲的战斗方式，更喜欢正面碾压。
但此刻战场混乱，她必须应对。
“是吗？那这样呢？”妖月璃轻笑，九轮噬月神影突然大放光芒，九道冰冷的月华光柱从天而降。
并非直接攻击叶凰，而是在她周围形成一个诡异的九宫阵势。
阵势一成，叶凰顿时感觉周身温度骤降，连神火的燃烧都似乎变得迟滞了一些。
更有一股无形的吸力从九轮神影中传来，试图吞噬她散发出的神火精华与生命元气。
“太阴噬月阵？”叶凰眉头微皱，感受到了一丝威胁。这妖女果然难缠。
“叶修哥哥，你的血海，似乎对奴家的月华很感兴趣呢？”另一边，妖月璃的一个主要分身，却出现在距离叶修不远的地方。
月华领域悄然蔓延，试图与叶修那翻腾的血海冥河领域接触。
content_en:
Ye Xin and Ye Xin looked at each other, with a trace of determination flashing in their eyes.
"Gods and demons are one, light and darkness come from the same source, and chaos has begun!"
The two of them screamed at the same time, and the realm of gods and demons suddenly shrank, and then exploded!
The sacred light and dark demonic energy are no longer distinct, but are intertwined and rotated wildly, and finally turned into a gray chaotic energy, as if the heaven and earth were not opened!
Although this chaotic energy is far less profound and grand than the chaotic origins of Ye Tian and Ao Canggu, it contains the unique mystery of the birth and death of light and darkness, and the transformation of gods and demons!
The spear of holy light pierced into this nascent chaos, and the power of purification exploded wildly, but it was like a mud cow entering the sea.
Being constantly consumed, decomposed, and transformed by the energy of chaos, the light of the spear itself quickly dimmed.
The golden Buddha palm struck into the chaos, and the "卍" Buddha seal on the palm shone brightly, trying to stabilize the chaos.
However, it caused the energy of chaos to surge violently, and the power of light and darkness clashed wildly in it. The explosion actually blew up the Buddha's palm, causing the Buddha's light to collapse and the shadow to dim!
"What?!" Sheng Yaoshi and Du Xin exclaimed at the same time. Their full blow was actually blocked or even broken by the twins in such a strange way!
Taking this opportunity, Ye Xin's figure blended into the nascent chaos, and her breath became erratic, as if between the sacred and evil, existence and nothingness.
Although their breath dropped slightly due to the explosion just now, their eyes were brighter, and their understanding of the power of gods and demons seemed to be deeper.
"The power of Nirvana, so that's it..." Ye Huang was on the other side of the battlefield. Her opponents were the entanglement of Buddha's light from Du Xin and the charming moonlight from Yaoyueli that struck from time to time.
Nine-colored divine fire burned around her, burning and purifying the incoming Buddha's light, and evaporating the charming moonlight.
Her eyes caught a glimpse of the beginning of chaos erupting over Ye Xin's side, and she felt enlightened.
The core of her innate Divine Phoenix Yuanling Holy Body is "Nirvana" and "Sacred Fire". Nirvana is destruction and rebirth, destruction and rebirth.
The integration of gods and demons, the contrast between light and darkness, isn't it also a kind of ultimate "destruction"?
If she could understand the deeper meaning of "rebirth from destruction", her path to Nirvana might be able to go a step further.
"Keke, sister Ye Huang, it's not good to be distracted during the battle." Yao Yueli's charming voice sounded in her ears, and a bone-chilling moonlight with endless temptation quietly struck Ye Huang's heart.
In the moonlight, there are countless enchanting figures dancing vaguely, which can confuse people's minds.
Ye Huang snorted coldly and without looking back, the divine fire suddenly erupted behind him, turning into a phantom of a divine phoenix that was about to fly.
The divine phoenix roared, and the blazing divine fire burned the incoming charming moonlight together with the demonic shadows within it.
"Demon girl, your tricks are of no use to me." Ye Huang turned around, the divine fire in his eyes locked onto Yao Yueli's looming figure in the moonlight.
She doesn't like this weird way of fighting, and prefers to crush them head-on.
But now the battlefield is chaotic and she must deal with it.
"Really? What about this?" Yaoyueli chuckled, and the nine-round moon-devouring divine shadow suddenly shined brightly, and nine icy moonlight beams fell from the sky.
It did not attack Ye Huang directly, but formed a strange nine palace formation around her.
As soon as the formation was completed, Ye Huang suddenly felt that the temperature of his body dropped sharply, and even the burning of the divine fire seemed to be sluggish.
There is also an invisible suction force coming from the Nine-wheeled Divine Shadow, trying to swallow the divine fire essence and life energy that she exudes.
"Taiyin Moon Devouring Formation?" Ye Huang frowned slightly, feeling a hint of threat. This witch is indeed difficult to deal with.
"Brother Ye Xiu, your Blood Sea seems to be very interested in Yuehua from the slave family?" On the other side, a main clone of Yao Yueli appeared not far from Ye Xiu.
The Moonlight Domain spread quietly, trying to make contact with Ye Xiu's churning Blood Sea Styx Domain.
